caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box shown from two perspectives: a top view of the closed lid and a perspective view of the opened box. The lid, displayed above, is decorated with brass or gold-colored studs that form a border and curved patterns, with a prominent oval-shaped, floral-embossed brass ornament in the center. The body of the box, shown below with the lid open, reveals that the interior is lined with a pink, marbled or textured material. The same gold-colored studs decorate the exterior seams and corners of the box, with curved patterns that correspond to those on the lid. There is also an ornate, gold-colored metal clasp on the front side of the box. The background of the drawing is plain and a light cream color.
title: Letter Box
